reasoning
The problem is the dispatch helper I added can't accept Tensor optionals for host-side dispatch cleanly because optional<Tensor> and IValue is a mess. Better to avoid IValue and just dispatch directly with explicit if conditions. Let me rewrite this the simplest way possible. Also I need cuda compilation flags - "-O3" and target sm_90.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

CUDA_SOURCE = r'''
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <ATen/cuda/CUDAContext.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <c10/cuda/CUDAGuard.h>
#include <cfloat>

static inline __device__ int8_t float_to_int8_rn(float x) {
    uint32_t dst;
    asm volatile("cvt.rni.sat.s8.f32 %0, %1;" : "=r"(dst) : "f"(x));
    return (int8_t)dst;
}

static inline __device__ int32_t float_to_int32_rn(float x) {
    uint32_t dst;
    asm volatile("cvt.rni.sat.s32.f32 %0, %1;" : "=r"(dst) : "f"(x));
    return (int32_t)dst;
}

static inline __device__ int8_t int32_to_int8(int32_t x) {
    uint32_t dst;
    asm volatile("cvt.sat.s8.s32 %0, %1;" : "=r"(dst) : "r"(x));
    return (int8_t)dst;
}

template <typename scalar_t>
__global__ void static_scaled_int8_quant_kernel(
    const scalar_t* __restrict__ input,
    int8_t* __restrict__ output,
    const float* scale_ptr,
    int hidden_size) {
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int stride = blockDim.x;
    const int64_t token_idx = blockIdx.x;
    const float scale = *scale_ptr;
    const scalar_t* row_in = input + token_idx * hidden_size;
    int8_t* row_out = output + token_idx * hidden_size;
    for (int i = tid; i < hidden_size; i += stride) {
        row_out[i] = float_to_int8_rn(static_cast<float>(row_in[i]) / scale);
    }
}

template <typename scalar_t>
__global__ void static_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel(
    const scalar_t* __restrict__ input,
    int8_t* __restrict__ output,
    const float* scale_ptr,
    int32_t azp,
    int hidden_size) {
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int stride = blockDim.x;
    const int64_t token_idx = blockIdx.x;
    const float scale = *scale_ptr;
    const scalar_t* row_in = input + token_idx * hidden_size;
    int8_t* row_out = output + token_idx * hidden_size;
    for (int i = tid; i < hidden_size; i += stride) {
        float val = static_cast<float>(row_in[i]) / scale;
        row_out[i] = int32_to_int8(float_to_int32_rn(val) + azp);
    }
}

template <typename scalar_t>
__global__ void dynamic_scaled_int8_quant_kernel(
    const scalar_t* __restrict__ input,
    int8_t* __restrict__ output,
    float* __restrict__ scale_out,
    int hidden_size) {
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int stride = blockDim.x;
    const int64_t token_idx = blockIdx.x;
    const scalar_t* row_in = input + token_idx * hidden_size;
    int8_t* row_out = output + token_idx * hidden_size;

    float local_max = 0.0f;
    for (int i = tid; i < hidden_size; i += stride) {
        local_max = fmaxf(local_max, fabsf(static_cast<float>(row_in[i])));
    }

    __shared__ float sdata[256];
    sdata[tid] = local_max;
    __syncthreads();
    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {
        if (tid < s) {
            sdata[tid] = fmaxf(sdata[tid], sdata[tid + s]);
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }

    float absmax = sdata[0];
    if (tid == 0) {
        scale_out[token_idx] = absmax / 127.0f;
    }
    float inv_s = (absmax == 0.0f) ? 0.0f : 127.0f / absmax;
    __syncthreads();

    for (int i = tid; i < hidden_size; i += stride) {
        row_out[i] = float_to_int8_rn(static_cast<float>(row_in[i]) * inv_s);
    }
}

template <typename scalar_t>
__global__ void dynamic_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel(
    const scalar_t* __restrict__ input,
    int8_t* __restrict__ output,
    float* __restrict__ scale_out,
    int32_t* __restrict__ azp_out,
    int hidden_size) {
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int stride = blockDim.x;
    const int64_t token_idx = blockIdx.x;
    const scalar_t* row_in = input + token_idx * hidden_size;
    int8_t* row_out = output + token_idx * hidden_size;

    float local_min = FLT_MAX;
    float local_max = -FLT_MAX;
    for (int i = tid; i < hidden_size; i += stride) {
        float val = static_cast<float>(row_in[i]);
        local_min = fminf(local_min, val);
        local_max = fmaxf(local_max, val);
    }

    __shared__ float s_min[256];
    __shared__ float s_max[256];
    s_min[tid] = local_min;
    s_max[tid] = local_max;
    __syncthreads();
    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {
        if (tid < s) {
            s_min[tid] = fminf(s_min[tid], s_min[tid + s]);
            s_max[tid] = fmaxf(s_max[tid], s_max[tid + s]);
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }

    float mm_min = s_min[0];
    float mm_max = s_max[0];
    if (tid == 0) {
        float s = (mm_max - mm_min) / 255.0f;
        float zp = nearbyintf(-128.0f - mm_min / s);
        scale_out[token_idx] = s;
        azp_out[token_idx] = (int32_t)zp;
        s_min[0] = (s == 0.0f) ? 0.0f : 1.0f / s;
        s_max[0] = (int32_t)zp;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    float inv_s = s_min[0];
    int32_t azp = (int32_t)s_max[0];
    for (int i = tid; i < hidden_size; i += stride) {
        float val = static_cast<float>(row_in[i]) * inv_s;
        row_out[i] = int32_to_int8(float_to_int32_rn(val) + azp);
    }
}

void static_scaled_int8_quant_cuda(
    torch::Tensor& out,
    const torch::Tensor& input,
    const torch::Tensor& scale,
    c10::optional<torch::Tensor> azp) {
    TORCH_CHECK(input.is_contiguous(), "input must be contiguous");
    TORCH_CHECK(out.is_contiguous(), "out must be contiguous");
    TORCH_CHECK(scale.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Float, "scale must be float");
    TORCH_CHECK(scale.numel() == 1, "scale must be scalar");
    if (azp.has_value()) {
        TORCH_CHECK(azp->numel() == 1, "azp must be scalar");
    }

    int hidden_size = input.size(-1);
    int num_tokens = input.numel() / hidden_size;
    int block_size = std::min(hidden_size, 256);
    if (block_size < 1) block_size = 1;
    int grid_size = num_tokens;
    const cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream();

    if (input.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Half) {
        if (!azp.has_value()) {
            static_scaled_int8_quant_kernel<at::Half><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::Half>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scale.data_ptr<float>(), hidden_size);
        } else {
            int32_t azp_val = azp->item<int32_t>();
            static_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel<at::Half><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::Half>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scale.data_ptr<float>(), azp_val, hidden_size);
        }
    } else if (input.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::BFloat16) {
        if (!azp.has_value()) {
            static_scaled_int8_quant_kernel<at::BFloat16><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::BFloat16>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scale.data_ptr<float>(), hidden_size);
        } else {
            int32_t azp_val = azp->item<int32_t>();
            static_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel<at::BFloat16><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::BFloat16>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scale.data_ptr<float>(), azp_val, hidden_size);
        }
    } else {
        if (!azp.has_value()) {
            static_scaled_int8_quant_kernel<float><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scale.data_ptr<float>(), hidden_size);
        } else {
            int32_t azp_val = azp->item<int32_t>();
            static_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel<float><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scale.data_ptr<float>(), azp_val, hidden_size);
        }
    }
}

void dynamic_scaled_int8_quant_cuda(
    torch::Tensor& out,
    const torch::Tensor& input,
    torch::Tensor& scales,
    c10::optional<torch::Tensor> azp) {
    TORCH_CHECK(input.is_contiguous(), "input must be contiguous");
    TORCH_CHECK(out.is_contiguous(), "out must be contiguous");
    TORCH_CHECK(scales.is_contiguous(), "scales must be contiguous");
    if (azp.has_value()) {
        TORCH_CHECK(azp->is_contiguous(), "azp must be contiguous");
    }

    int hidden_size = input.size(-1);
    int num_tokens = input.numel() / hidden_size;
    int block_size = std::min(hidden_size, 256);
    if (block_size < 1) block_size = 1;
    int grid_size = num_tokens;
    const cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream();

    if (input.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Half) {
        if (!azp.has_value()) {
            dynamic_scaled_int8_quant_kernel<at::Half><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::Half>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scales.data_ptr<float>(), hidden_size);
        } else {
            dynamic_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel<at::Half><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::Half>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scales.data_ptr<float>(), azp->data_ptr<int32_t>(), hidden_size);
        }
    } else if (input.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::BFloat16) {
        if (!azp.has_value()) {
            dynamic_scaled_int8_quant_kernel<at::BFloat16><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::BFloat16>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scales.data_ptr<float>(), hidden_size);
        } else {
            dynamic_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel<at::BFloat16><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<at::BFloat16>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scales.data_ptr<float>(), azp->data_ptr<int32_t>(), hidden_size);
        }
    } else {
        if (!azp.has_value()) {
            dynamic_scaled_int8_quant_kernel<float><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scales.data_ptr<float>(), hidden_size);
        } else {
            dynamic_scaled_int8_azp_quant_kernel<float><<<grid_size, block_size, 0, stream>>>(
                input.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<int8_t>(),
                scales.data_ptr<float>(), azp->data_ptr<int32_t>(), hidden_size);
        }
    }
}

PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME, m) {
    m.def("static_scaled_int8_quant", &static_scaled_int8_quant_cuda);
    m.def("dynamic_scaled_int8_quant", &dynamic_scaled_int8_quant_cuda);
}
'''

_mod = load_inline(
    name="int8_quant_h100_v9",
    cpp_sources="",
    cuda_sources=CUDA_SOURCE,
    extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
    verbose=False,
)

static_scaled_int8_quant = _mod.static_scaled_int8_quant
dynamic_scaled_int8_quant = _mod.dynamic_scaled_int8_quant


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, K, N):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(K, N, dtype=torch.float16, device='cuda')

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.linear(x)
        out_static = torch.empty_like(y, dtype=torch.int8)
        scale = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
        static_scaled_int8_quant(out_static, y, scale, None)
        out_dynamic = torch.empty_like(y, dtype=torch.int8)
        scales = torch.empty(y.size(0), dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
        dynamic_scaled_int8_quant(out_dynamic, y, scales, None)
        return out_static, out_dynamic, scales
